_comment: TEMPLATE. The architect agent writes this file for a real problem; setup.py
then validates it and rewrites it in canonical form, so the bytes on disk are
a function of the values alone. Keys not listed below are dropped.
This is the ONLY per-problem input the verification harness needs:
scripts/verify.py is byte-identical in every project and reads its
configuration from here at run time.
project           source directory and root namespace, e.g. "Erdos477".
problem           one-line human-readable title; names the generated logs.
theorems          every frozen theorem name, in the order the BLUEPRINT
stages prove them. These are binding: Theorems.lean,
Solution.lean and the harness all use them.
final_theorem     OPTIONAL. The headline theorem, required only to enable
mandatory_axioms  OPTIONAL. Fully-qualified axioms that final_theorem must
GENUINELY DEPEND ON. The allowlist check only rejects
EXTRA axioms, so without this a proof that quietly took a
route avoiding a permitted certificate would pass. Set
both only when USER_NOTES.md mandates a proof route.
